name: Tensor Field Topological Segmentation
definition: A segmentation method for 2D tensor fields that decomposes the domain into cells based on the topological skeleton formed by separatrices (radial tensorlines bounding hyperbolic sectors) and degenerate points, followed by adaptive refinement based on eigenvalue similarity.
summary: Tensor Field Topological Segmentation decomposes symmetric tensor fields into cells using topological skeletons, uniquely handling eigenvector ambiguity at degenerate points to capture global structural features.
